solid_body = Box(plate_length, plate_width, plate_thickness)

solid_body = solid_body - Box(slot_length, slot_width, plate_thickness)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, rib_z) * Box(rib_length, rib_width, rib_depth)

notch_depth = 12.0

notch = Pos(bracket_length/2 - bracket_thickness/2, notch_depth/2, 0) * Box(bracket_thickness, notch_width, notch_depth)

rib = Pos(0, 0, -bracket_thickness/2 - rib_height/2) * Box(bracket_length, rib_width, rib_height)

    x = -bracket_length/2 + hole_margin + i * hole_spacing
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, bracket_thickness + rib_height + 2)
